pred_texts: Instruct: First, get a baguette and slice four half-inch thick pieces from it.
Instruct: Next, toast the baguette slices in the toaster. Toast until golden brown usually around 1 minute.
Instruct: Now, brush each toast lightly with some olive oil.
Instruct: Now, dice half a tomato.
Instruct: Now, cut four slices of fresh mozzarella as a topping for your toasts.
Instruct: You need to now wash the basil and chop it into small pieces.
Instruct: Now, mix the tomatoes and the basil together and add some salt.
Instruct: Now, get a baguette slice and put a slice of mozzarella on top.
Instruct: Next add the toppings of tomato and basil on the baguette slice such that it covers it.
Instruct: Now, repeat the previous step for all your toasts.
